title: Resume Content (Superset / Ground Truth)
description: Content-only resume document. Carries ZERO styling — all presentation lives in a theme preset. A superset of the JSON Resume standard: interoperable field names, extended with multiple summary variants, per-role multiple titles/date ranges, company domain notes, an open-source-contributions section, flagged alternate values, projects, certifications, recommendations, languages, job-search preferences, and a company-context appendix. Nearly every field is OPTIONAL so a trimmed/tailored document still renders (graceful degradation). Additional properties are permitted on content objects.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this content schema the document targets.

theme.description: Name of the theme preset to render with (resolved to themes/<name>.theme.json). CLI --theme overrides this.

sectionOrder.description: Explicit render order of sections. Any omitted-but-present section is appended in canonical order after the listed ones. Unknown names are ignored.

basics.description: Identity and contact block. Mirrors JSON Resume 'basics', extended with multiple summary variants and a tagline.

label.description: Headline / tagline shown under the name.

display.description: Pre-formatted location string; if present, used verbatim in the header.
Text to show for the link; defaults to url without scheme.

summary.description: Single default summary. Superseded by 'summaries.default' if that is present.

summaries.description: Named summary variants (e.g. default, golang, nodejs, ai, platform). The renderer uses summaries[activeSummary] || summaries.default || summary. In the FULL ground-truth document, ALL variants are listed under the Summary section for reference.

activeSummary.description: Which named summary to use as THE summary in a tailored render. If unset, the ground-truth document lists every variant; a tailored doc typically sets this to one key.

preferences.description: Job-search targeting metadata (locations, roles). Rendered as a short section in the ground-truth doc; usually omitted from a tailored resume.

work.description: Work experience. Extends JSON Resume 'work' with a domain note and multiple roles (title + date range) per company for promotions.

domainNote.description: Short italic descriptor of what the company does.

position.description: Single title (JSON Resume compatible). Used when 'roles' is absent.

startDate.description: ISO 8601 (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD). Used when 'roles' is absent.

dateDisplay.description: Pre-formatted combined date range for the company header line; overrides computed range.

roleDisplay.description: How to show multiple roles at this company. 'separate' (default): one line per role with its own dates. 'senior-only': show only the most-senior title (first in 'roles') spanning the company's full date range (a 'continued role'). 'combined': join titles on one line over the full span. For a company with 2+ roles, the JD-tailoring agent must ask the user which treatment to use before rendering.

roles.description: Multiple titles/date ranges within one company (e.g. intern -> engineer).

highlights.description: Bullet points. Each may be a plain string OR an object with flagged/alt metadata for tailoring.

alt.description: Alternate phrasing (kept for reference; not rendered unless selected).

flagged.description: If true, a Word comment is attached noting the flag/resolution.

studyType.description: Degree type, e.g. Bachelor of Technology.

degreeDisplay.description: Pre-formatted degree line; overrides area/studyType composition.

score.description: CGPA / GPA. May carry a flag via scoreNote/scoreFlagged.

skills.description: Skill groups. 'name' is the category label; 'keywords' the items.

keywordsText.description: Pre-joined items string; overrides keywords when present.

openSource.description: Open-source contributions section (extension beyond JSON Resume).

note.description: Italic caveat/verification note (e.g. which figures are self-reported vs verified).

certificationsNote.description: Italic caveat rendered above the certifications list.

languages.description: Spoken/written languages. Each has a language and optional fluency.

companyContext.description: Appendix: short factual background per company (ground-truth aid).

about.description: Optional 'about this document' banner (used by the ground-truth doc; usually omitted in tailored resumes).
